verdict.rationale: cubic documents a public Analytics API, but it only exposes PR-level data such as issues flagged, issues fixed and AI-authored code, so it reads results rather than drives the product. Programmatic control is offered through the official MCP server, which can request PR reviews, triage scan issues, read findings and manage seats, and through the CLI. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any standard path. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST API for triggering reviews, scans and configuration, a published OpenAPI/reference spec, auth and rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
